flashcard_questions.q: A designer responsible for planning how light is used in a performance, including colour, intensity, direction, and special effects.
A designer responsible for sourcing and creating all audio elements in a production, including sound effects, music, and amplification.
A broad, even spread of light across the whole stage or a large area of it.

flashcard_questions.a: A gradual transition where one lighting state fades out as another fades in, creating a smooth change in mood.
Sound that exists within the world of the play and can be heard by the characters on stage.
